'''Chocolate Cake''' is a [[Cooking|cooked dish]]. It is prepared using either the kitchen inside an upgraded [[farmhouse]] or a [[Cookout Kit]]. Three Chocolate Cakes are the reward for completing the {{Bundle|2,500||y}}.

'''Note''': this recipe is [[Cooking#Profitable Recipes|profitable]] - it will always result in profit if using the lowest quality [[Egg]] as well as [[Wheat Flour]] and [[Sugar]] from the [[Mill]].

Chocolate Cake may randomly appear in [[Krobus]]' shop on [[Days of the Week#Saturday|Saturdays]], in the [[Garbage Can]] outside the saloon, or in [[the Stardrop Saloon]]'s rotating stock. One Chocolate Cake may be received from opening a [[Mystery Box]].

==Bundles==
Chocolate Cake is not used in any [[bundles]].

==Tailoring==
Chocolate Cake is used in the spool of the [[2 Willow Lane#Sewing Machine|Sewing Machine]] to create the {{Name|Party Hat (blue)|class=inline}}. It can be used in [[dyeing]], serving as an orange dye at the dye pots, located in [[Emily]]'s and [[Haley]]'s house, [[2 Willow Lane]].

==Quests==
Chocolate Cake is needed for the quest "Haley's Cake-Walk" during her [[Haley#Fourteen Hearts|14-Heart event]].
